purpose: Document first-party local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The WUP point identifies Kharagpur in West Bengal. State land-map services and local valuation administration are confirmed, but anonymous geometry is not; the industrial-park map is limited and must not be generalized to the city. No property, owner, address, plot, khatian or title lookup was submitted. No full parcel geometry was retained.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official West Bengal Land and Land Reforms portal lists plot-map requests and Mouza Map Availability Details among state land-record services.
Official West Bengal Urban Development and Municipal Affairs procedure says Know Your Property viewing requires OTP-based registration, then district, block, mouza and plot/khatian selection.
NIC West Bengal describes the eBhuchitra/Banglarbhumi project as real-time RoR and plot information, with digitally signed plot maps available as a citizen service.

Official West Bengal Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation map is a field-survey cadastral drawing for Kharagpur Industrial Park, specifically named mouzas and industrial units; limited project area, not a citywide parcel layer.

West Bengal Valuation Board has a local Kharagpur Municipality valuation notice among its municipal land/building valuation records; this is municipal valuation administration, not vector parcel geometry.

attempts.result: Plot Map Request and Mouza Map Availability services shown; no plot lookup submitted.
OTP account, district/block/mouza and specific plot/khatian required; stopped without registering or entering identifiers.
Map is limited to Kharagpur Industrial Park and named mouzas; not used as citywide coverage.
